demo_in = [[8]*19 for _ in range(18)]
for r,c in [(3,5),(4,12),(5,3),(6,16),(8,11),(10,8),(13,7),(14,2),(15,8),(17,3),(17,15)]: demo_in[r][c]=7
demo_in[12][13:18]=[4,4,0,0,0]
demo_out=[[8]*19 for _ in range(18)]
for r,c in [(3,5),(4,12),(5,3),(6,16),(8,11),(10,8),(13,7),(14,2),(15,8),(17,3),(17,15)]: demo_out[r][c-2:c+3]=[4,4,0,0,0]
demo_out[12][13:18]=[4,4,0,0,0]
# Write transform implementation.
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    # The key is the longest horizontal contiguous run of non-background cells.
    runs = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != bg:
                c += 1
            if c - start > 1:
                runs.append((c - start, r, start, row[start:c][:]))
    _, kr, ks, motif = max(runs)
    keycells = {(kr, ks+i) for i in range(len(motif))}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, val in enumerate(row):
            if val == bg or (r, c) in keycells:
                continue
            # Markers are isolated points distinct from the horizontal key.
            if (c == 0 or row[c-1] == bg) and (c+1 == w or row[c+1] == bg):
                start = c - len(motif)//2
                for i, color in enumerate(motif):
                    if 0 <= start+i < w:
                        out[r][start+i] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),globals())
print(transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
print(transform(demo_in)[3])
